evidence.note: R3 is a two-stage post-training recipe (SFT mid-training on expert reasoning traces, then rubric-based single-step RL on offline instruction-only data) that trains a vision-language model to produce free-form natural-language reasoning steering a frozen low-level robot policy, and shows this test-time reasoning causally improves generalization beyond what training-time reasoning supervision alone provides.
evidence.title: $R^3$: Training Robots to Reason in Natural Language via Reinforcement Learning

name: Gemini 3 Flash (expert reasoner for data collection)
